reason: My admin already types the receipts into Excel every week. It's behind, sure, but it gets done, and I'm not paying a monthly fee and moving everything to Google Sheets to fix something that roughly works.

would_change_my_mind: Seeing it catch real duplicates or mistakes in our own old chat history with the free 40 documents, and showing me money we were actually losing.
